changes.commit: fix(proxmox): strip secrets from guest instance JSON
steps: In each final instance-data writer, derive the JSON payload from its existing `homelabinfra_instance.lxc` or `.vm` dictionary by converting it to items, rejecting the shared denylist `api_token_secret`, `api_token_id`, `password`, `pubkey`, and `sshkeys`, converting it back to a dictionary, and applying `to_nice_json` only to that filtered copy.

Keep the existing full instance dictionaries, Proxmox module argument preparation and invocation, node delegation, and status/exec waits unchanged; apply filtering only to the heredoc payload written after readiness succeeds.

Replace each `/root/home/homelabinfra_instance.<guest>.json` target with `/root/homelabinfra_instance.<guest>.json`, and update the in-guest shell command to create the file with an explicit 0600 mode, including when it already exists.
Update each task name and inline command consistently so the LXC and VM writers describe and implement the same sanitized, protected metadata contract.
tests: Inspect the two writer-task diffs to confirm the denylist is applied before `to_nice_json`, the destination is `/root/homelabinfra_instance.<guest>.json`, and the command explicitly enforces mode 0600.
changes.title: Sanitize persisted Proxmox guest instance JSON

context: Provisioning builds full `homelabinfra_instance.lxc` and `.vm` dictionaries because the Proxmox modules require API credentials and guest SSH/bootstrap values. The final writer task in each create file then serializes that same full dictionary through a heredoc on the selected Proxmox node into the newly running guest. The current writers use `/root/home/`, which has no repository consumer, and a plain redirect whose permissions depend on umask. `ansible/tasks/proxmox/lxc-create.yml` carries `api_token_id`, `api_token_secret`, `password`, and `pubkey`; `ansible/tasks/proxmox/vm-create.yml` carries `api_token_id`, `api_token_secret`, and `sshkeys`. The change must derive a filtered serialization only at each writer, denylisting `api_token_secret`, `api_token_id`, `password`, `pubkey`, and `sshkeys`; it must not alter the complete dictionaries supplied to `community.proxmox.proxmox` or `community.proxmox.proxmox_kvm`, their allowlist preparation, or the status and exec waits. Each writer will use `/root/homelabinfra_instance.<guest>.json` and explicitly leave that file mode 0600. This follows the secrets-handling rule that managed-guest metadata contains no auth keys, while preserving the existing node delegation and shell transport.

matter.content:
### Goal
Stop writing the Proxmox API token and LXC root password into every provisioned guest: strip auth
keys from the instance JSON that `lxc-create.yml` and `vm-create.yml` persist inside the guest,
and fix the odd `/root/home` destination path.

### Context
`ansible/tasks/proxmox/lxc-create.yml:96-103` pipes `homelabinfra_instance.lxc | to_nice_json`
into the new container at `/root/home/homelabinfra_instance.lxc.json`;
`ansible/tasks/proxmox/vm-create.yml:100-107` does the same via `qm guest exec` for VMs. That
dict is the full module-args dict built at lxc-create.yml:18-29 / vm-create.yml:16-31 and
contains `api_token_secret` (full Proxmox API control) and, for LXC, `password` (root password,
default `changeme` from `vars/homelabinfra-defaults.yml:12`). The file is written with default
umask (world-readable). Per specs/secrets-handling.md, no secret may be persisted into a managed
guest.

Fix shape: filter the dict before dumping — drop at least `api_token_secret`, `api_token_id`,
`password`, `pubkey`/`sshkeys` (e.g. `dict2items | rejectattr('key', 'in', <denylist>) |
items2dict`), write with mode 0600, and settle the destination path (`/root/home/` is almost
certainly a typo for `/root/`; nothing else in the repo reads this file yet — grep to confirm
before choosing). Related: meta slice 003 will replace the dict-splat module call with an
allowlist; this item only sanitizes the persisted copy and should not restructure the module
call.

### Acceptance criteria
- The JSON written into a guest by `lxc-create.yml` and `vm-create.yml` contains no
  `api_token_secret`, `api_token_id`, `password`, or SSH key material (checkable from the diff:
  the denylist/filter is applied in both files).
- The in-guest file lands at a sane path with 0600 permissions.
- No other behavior of the create tasks changes (module call, waits untouched).
- The `lint` gate from `.claude/build.yml` passes on the touched files.

prerequisites: ansible/tasks/proxmox/lxc-create.yml (task 'Write LXC instance data to /root/home', currently lines 145-153) pipes `homelabinfra_instance.lxc | to_nice_json` into the guest via `pct exec`, and that dict carries `api_token_secret`, `api_token_id`, `password`, and `pubkey`.

ansible/tasks/proxmox/vm-create.yml (task 'Write VM instance data to /root/home', currently lines 165-173) pipes `homelabinfra_instance.vm | to_nice_json` into the guest via `qm guest exec`, and that dict carries `api_token_secret`, `api_token_id`, and `sshkeys`.
Both writers land the file under `/root/home/` and use a plain `cat` redirect, so the file inherits default umask (world-readable) rather than an explicit 0600 mode.

No file in the repository reads `homelabinfra_instance.lxc.json` or `homelabinfra_instance.vm.json`; the only references are the two writer tasks, so the in-guest destination path can change without breaking any consumer.
The `lint` and `test` gates referenced by the acceptance criteria are registered in `.isotope/isotope.json` and runnable via `.claude/gate/lint.sh` and `.claude/gate/test.sh`.

rounds.abstract: Sanitized the LXC and VM guest instance metadata payloads, moved them to /root, and explicitly enforced mode 0600 without changing Proxmox module calls or readiness waits.
rounds.details: Each final writer now derives its serialized payload from the existing full homelabinfra_instance.lxc or .vm dictionary by applying dict2items, rejecting the shared denylist api_token_secret, api_token_id, password, pubkey, and sshkeys, restoring a dictionary with items2dict, and then applying to_nice_json. The existing full dictionaries, module-argument allowlists and calls, node delegation, and status/exec wait tasks are unchanged. Both writers now target /root/homelabinfra_instance.<guest>.json and execute umask 077 plus chmod 0600 in the guest command, including when the file already exists. Diff review satisfies AC1-AC3. The lint gate passed. The mandated test gate failed solely in unrelated repository playbooks because the docker role is unavailable, instance is undefined in two maintenance playbooks, and the rollback playbook is empty; its output contains no error for either modified file or the Proxmox create playbooks.
